correctness.rationale: PASS. P(13)=Cay(Z13,{±1,±3,±4}), 13 vertices, 39 edges and 26 clique triangles; no 4-cliques. With the triangular-plane universal cover and deck lattice L={(a,b):a+3b≡0 mod 13}, H1(T13,1,3;Z)=L≅Z². The common-neighbour Paley (13,6,2,3) parameters give 78 un-oriented 4-cycles, of which 39 are chorded and triangulated, leaving exactly 39 induced cycles. An independent code enumerated all simple 4-cycles and their translated lift vectors: the 39 induced cycles form three translation orbits of size 13 with unoriented classes (-1,-3),(-1,-4),(0,-1); the signed representatives in the source are (1,3),(1,4),(0,-1). These vectors are primitive and a pair forms determinant ±1, so they generate H1 integrally. Triangles are faces and there are no shorter nonzero-H1 cycles. The affine group order 78 permutes all 39 induced quadrilaterals. The cover/lattice proof is exact, not inference about all n from a finite sample.
